# Sanvex

> Laravel integrations for AI agents with managed auth and support for GitHub, Gmail, Linear, Notion, Slack, and custom drivers.

## What is Sanvex

Sanvex is a Laravel integration layer. Resolve a driver by id, then call resource actions:

SanvexManager → resolveDriver('github') → repositories()->list([...])

Packages: sanvex/core (manager, encryption, DB), sanvex/cli (artisan commands), sanvex/mcp (MCP server), sanvex/laravel-ai (Laravel AI tools), sanvex/{driver} (per service).

Requires PHP 8.2+ and Laravel 12 or 13.

## Quickstart

```bash
composer require sanvex/core sanvex/cli sanvex/github
php artisan migrate
php artisan sanvex:setup github --api-key="ghp_..."
```

```php
use Sanvex\Core\SanvexManager;

$manager->resolveDriver('github')->repositories()->list(['per_page' => 10]);
```

## Database tables

- sv_accounts: encrypted credentials (owner_type, owner_id, driver, key_name)
- sv_entities: cached entities (driver, entity_type, entity_id, data)
- sv_events: webhook/event log
- sv_permissions: approval records for guarded actions
- sv_integrations: migration exists; not used by runtime code yet

Encryption: SANVEX_KEK env (or APP_KEY fallback). Generate with: php artisan sanvex:keygen

## Authentication

CLI: php artisan sanvex:setup {driver} --api-key= --bot-token= --owner-type= --owner-id=

Token resolution order: api_key → bot_token → access_token

Driver auth types:
- github: api_key, oauth2 (default api_key)
- gmail: oauth2 only
- linear: api_key, oauth2
- notion: api_key, oauth_2 — OAuth routes at /sanvex/notion/login
- slack: api_key, oauth2 — use --bot-token for bot tokens

Only Notion has built-in OAuth web routes in this repo.

## Tenancy

$manager->for($owner)->resolveDriver('notion')->pages()->list([...]);

Global default: owner_type=global, owner_id=default.

## Laravel AI

composer require sanvex/laravel-ai

Single tool: app(SanvexAi::class)->tool()
Per-operation tools: app(SanvexAi::class)->driver('github')->tools()

System introspection: {"driver":"system","resource":"drivers","action":"list.configured","args":{}}

## MCP

composer require sanvex/mcp
php artisan sanvex:mcp-stdio

Optional HTTP: SANVEX_MCP_ENABLE_SERVER=true → GET /sanvex/mcp/sse, POST /sanvex/mcp/message

Tools: sanvex_list_operations, sanvex_setup, sanvex_get_schema. RunScriptTool disabled by default.

## Driver setup examples

```bash
php artisan sanvex:setup github --api-key="ghp_..."
php artisan sanvex:setup slack --bot-token="xoxb-..."
php artisan sanvex:setup notion --api-key="secret_..."
php artisan sanvex:setup linear --api-key="lin_api_..."
```

Notion OAuth env: NOTION_CLIENT_ID, NOTION_CLIENT_SECRET, NOTION_REDIRECT_URI, NOTION_AUTH_TYPE=oauth_2
